change_from_v1: Save generic clicked-control DOM kind in the public synthetic semantic archive; compare a kind-aware goal policy against fixed and label-only policies
selection_rule: Most rewarded selections on validation; ties prefer first, last, goal_match, then goal_grounded
eligible_group: Exactly two independently reset actions with the same visible prestate, both terminal rewards observed, and opposite rewards
success_criterion: At least 10 eligible eval groups across at least two task pages; selected policy exceeds fixed-first success rate by at least 0.10 with no task-page regression
limits: One-step synthetic branch replay only. No unobserved branches or long-horizon exploration are simulated. This does not validate desktop transfer, Jev parity, or runtime promotion.
